name: MortgageOffer
description: The formal mortgage offer issued to the customer following underwriting approval (PH-014). Binding offer sets out loan amount, interest rate, APR, term, and conditions. Customer has a mandatory 7-day reflection period (MCOB 6.7) before accepting. Offer valid for 6 months. Owned by SVC-002.

fields.name: offered_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, GBP. <= loan_amount requested. Immutable.

fields.name: apr
fields.validation_rule: Required. Annual Percentage Rate per MCOB 10. Includes all fees. Immutable.

fields.name: offer_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Date offer issued. Immutable. Start of 7-day reflection period.

fields.name: conditions
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Conditions precedent to completion. Max 500 chars each.

fields.name: customer_accepted
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Cannot be true before offer_date + 7 days (MCOB 6.7).

fields.name: accepted_date
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when customer_accepted = true. Must be >= offer_date + 7 days and <= expiry_date.

fields.name: monthly_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Monthly repayment at offered_rate for full term. GBP. Immutable.

relationships.description: MortgageOffer is the source for one MortgageAccount created at completion.
